data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'marj' meaning 'gentle' and 'ana' meaning 'me'. It is also associated with the fragrant jasmine flower. The name Marjana carries the meaning “Gentle, Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Marjana usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Overall, the name Marjana can inspire individuals to strive towards inner peace, kindness, and a deeper connection to their faith.
